text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day just before her debut, Seiun Sky 
held a joint training session alongside 
her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week with her sharp finishing 
kick. Grass Wonder harboring a quiet 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa, aiming for global 
dominance. King Halo, a first-class lady.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by a generation stacked with 
formidable rivals, Seiun Sky still had no 
intention of giving an inch.
